original_history.first_failure: PowerShell colon interpolation parser fault; focused Go test and vet passed; no resource-screen process was executed and no science data consumed

controls.public_training: 8 fixed public utility-label pairs per episode, same label/features for trained LCRM and separate learned predictive peer
controls.source_origin: hand-authored source-free structural probes, not prospective scientific first-use

limitations: Source-free public stress probes are knowingly designed, not genuine unseen or independently originated tasks.

The equal-trained peer is a predictive-retention reference sharing an eight-parameter public utility learner; not a fully trained GRU, causal relational state learner, or comprehensive competitive baseline.
The existing LCRM encoder is not yet proven integrated with memory and downstream counterfactual inference.
A caller-provided intervention/randomization flag is not independently verified causal provenance.
Linux microsecond-scale CPU costs from five short processes are noisy; Windows process CPU quantizes to zero and cannot establish CPU equality.
No causal action-value scientific evidence, no counterfactual error calibration or source-born prospective transfer, no service-cost qualification.
No test-run evidence supports component-level learned transfer or independently reproduced CPU/RSS nonregression.
next_gate: LCRM01-O3: replace self-authored structural probe with fresh preregistered TRAIN/DEV, actual query-blind encoders and independently verifiable intervention assignment, fully trained recurrent/relational matched controls, causal ablations, cost-robust long-running benchmarks and novel operator families; no experiment until all source/control identities frozen and authority admits first-use.
